working_on.task: Completed Phase 01 to 03. Moving to Phase 04 (Production DB Migration).
working_on.notes: Security hardening applied to Orchestrator API (middleware + route guard). Persistence fixed for Envoy profiles. AI AI config stabilized with 3-tier fallback and lazy instantiation. Tests passed.

recent_changes.description: Phase 03: AI Config Stabilization. Added smart 3-tier fallback (Anthropic -> OpenAI -> Fallback), lazy instantiation of AI clients to fix 3s timeout when Anthropic key is missing.

Phase 01: Pre-deploy Security Hardening. Removed anonymous bypass for /api/dev and /api/orchestrator in middleware. Added requireAdmin guard to Orchestrator routes. Fixed saveBot metadata persistence.

errors_encountered.error: AI response delayed by 2-3s when Anthropic key missing
errors_encountered.solution: Created lazy getAnthropicClient() and 3-tier fallback chain. Skipping unconfigured providers instantly.

decisions_made.reason: Ensure bot pipelines do not fail if primary LLM service is down or unconfigured.
